text: >>18703671 Not really into their jeans. Just too clean cut and modern of a design. It’s all kind of soulless for my taste. Every now and then they have a really basic shirt that I dig. I’m considering getting this for summer. I’ve already got a blue striped oxford like this in a similar cut, but it would be nice to have some color variation, and white/cream tones are extremely easy to pair with literally anything
